criteria.description: the ego must pass the pedestrian with positive body clearance
criteria.reason: a clearance criterion needs a concrete actor pair, and the VRU role id varies across briefs in this category; true OBB clearance is enforced by gate C3 instead

originalIntent: Euro NCAP VRU AEB CPFA/CPNA/CPNC protocols. The pedestrian target crosses the ego path; the acceptance band is a near miss, and a contact is a failure of the scenario, not a success. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Pedestrian crossing conflict: the VRU must enter the ego path and the ego must not strike it
